text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock B in four equal batches as it fell and then rebounded slightly. Next time I’ll decide how much I’m willing to hold before selling in stages, rather than letting the latest price move dictate each sale.","I took a gain on some Stock A in period 1 but sold more at a deep loss in period 10. Taking a profit doesn’t make the remaining shares safer, so after each trim I’ll check how much of my account is still exposed.","I sold Stock D at several different prices. I won’t use my best past sale price as a target for the remaining shares; I’ll compare what I expect from holding them today with what I could do with the cash."]}
